name: Bhumaka
residence: Terrace Fields District, in the valley below the Shalavana hills, fed by hill-stream irrigation channels
personality: quietly observant more than he admits
daily_routine: assigning tasks among household workers and hired hands for the terraces
irrigation checks along the hill-fed channels that feed the terrace tanks
coordinating harvest storage timing with Marisha at the granary
occasional visits to the market street to trade or barter surplus grain

goals.public_goal: Keep the terrace fields productive year-round and prevent famine, in a kingdom whose taxes are paid mostly in grain
goals.hidden_goal: Expand the terrace fields toward the forest edge without open conflict with the crown's forest officers or the temple
goals.deep_goal: Ensure his family is never blamed if the crops fail again

beliefs: If people eat, they stop arguing (mostly)
Temple rites are fine as long as they don't delay planting
The hill-stream channels matter more than any legend
Drought is always closer than people think
